subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

DOGMATIC : EQHOBVJD :: PRODUCTS : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is 

**1. The logic involves shifting the letters of the word based on their position in the alphabet. 

2. If the place value of the letter is a single digit(0 - 9) i.e. A to I; then it is shifted by +1 positions forward in the alphabet.

3. **If the place value of the letter is a double-digit(10 - 26) i.e. J to Z then it is shifted by +2 positions forward in the alphabet.

**DOGMATIC : EQHOBVJD**

D (4th letter) -> E (shifted by 1)

O (15th letter) -> Q (shifted by 2)

G (7th letter) -> H (shifted by 1)

M (13th letter) -> O (shifted by 2)

A (1st letter) -> B (shifted by 1)

T (20th letter) -> V (shifted by 2)

I (9th letter) -> J (shifted by 1)

C (3rd letter) -> D (shifted by 1)

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75e8fb4eb9b64143d7d21295173e2d7c20b05a06553d6505dea104e2b6b3105d.png] 

Similarly,

** PRODUCTS : ?**

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f542c0f2fa1042db7afe1248495d181275a17ba39e596dc4ccaea597a853e5fb.png] ​

Hence, the correct answer is **"RTQEWDVU"**.
